t: Time 3093Y white flexible cable delivers reliable performance for storage heaters and immersion heater installations. This 10m coil features a robust 3-core design with brown, blue and green/yellow copper conductors rated 300/500V. The larger 1.5mm² conductor area manages higher current demands safely, whilst the heat-resistant PVC sheath withstands operating temperatures from -15°C to 90°C. With 27 strands per core, the cable provides exceptional flexibility for complex routing and secure, long-term connections in heating system applications.
b: Suitable for Storage Heaters & Immersion Heaters
